title: Updating Asset Records in the CMDB

blocks.text: Zscaler Asset Exposure Management (AEM) helps enhance Configuration Management Database (CMDB) hygiene by tracking assets within the CMDB, alerting you to missing or conflicting information, flagging assets with incomplete or inaccurate data in critical fields, and identifying assets that are missing from the CMDB. Maintaining an accurate, up-to-date, and complete CMDB is critical for improving operational efficiency and ensuring policy compliance.

The CMDB Hygiene policy rules that can be configured in the AEM app are designed to automatically detect and flag assets with incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent data within your CMDB. The detected policy violations are grouped into violation tickets based on the policy name and policy assignee.
Currently, this feature is only supported for ServiceNow CMDB.
To update asset records in your CMDB, make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: Ensure that you connect the relevant data source (e.g., ServiceNow Assets) to your account. To learn more, see Creating Data Sources.
Configure the CMBD outegration to dispatch assets from AEM to CMDB. To learn more, see Configuring the ServiceNow CMDB Outegration.

blocks.heading: Updating Asset Records in the CMDB

blocks.text: To update asset records in the CMDB:

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, click Violation Tickets.
Click the violation ticket you want to view.
The Details drawer appears which shows the violation event containing asset information.
Click the Update CMDB drop-down menu at the bottom of the Details drawer, and select the relevant option.
The Update assets to ServiceNow CMBD window appears.
All the assets associated with the selected ticket are updated in the CMDB.
If an asset does not exist, a new record for the asset is created in the CMDB.
If an asset already exists, the asset record is updated with the new or modified field values in the CMDB.

blocks.text: The CMDB update process time might vary, especially during bulk updates.
